WM-333.Objective: Validate the presence, order, and functionality of Youtube and LinkedIn related elements, headers, and links on the IEC Standards page.
WM-333.ExpectedResult:
1. The page URL should be: https://qa-regional.astm.org/standards/iec
2. The page should display the following headers in order:
   - Main Page Heading (H2): 'IEC Standards'
   - Section 1 Heading (H3): 'What is International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC)?'
   - Section 2 Heading (H3): 'Digital and PDF Access to IEC Standards'
   - Section 3 Heading (H3): 'Create a Technical Document Library'
   - Category Section Heading (H2): 'IEC Standards By Category'
   - Footer Heading (H2): 'For more information'
3. Button/Link Verification Below Headers:
   - Below 'What is International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC)?' header:
     - Button/Link: 'Contact Us' (links to /contact-us)
   - Below 'Digital and PDF Access to IEC Standards' header:
     - Button/Link: 'Meet with an ASTM representative' (links to booking page)
   - Below 'Create a Technical Document Library' header:
     - Button/Link: 'Learn More about ASTM Compass' (links to /standards/compass)
   - Below 'For more information' header:
     - Button/Link: 'Contact Us' (links to salesforce page)
     - Email Link: 'sales@astm.org' (mailto link)

Locators.name: MainPageHeading
Locators.description: Main H2 heading for IEC Standards

Locators.name: Section2Heading
Locators.locatorValue: //h3[text()='Digital and PDF Access to IEC Standards']

TestData.expectedText: Digital and PDF Access to IEC Standards

VerificationPoints: All headers are displayed with correct text content
All buttons/links are visible and clickable
Header hierarchy is correct (H2 for main sections, H3 for subsections)
Buttons are positioned immediately below or within their respective sections

EdgeCases.expected: Test should fail and log missing/incorrect header

EdgeCases.description: Button/link not visible or not clickable
EdgeCases.expected: Test should fail and log missing or disabled button/link
Test should fail and log actual vs expected URL

EdgeCases.description: Header hierarchy incorrect (e.g., H3 used instead of H2)
EdgeCases.expected: Test should fail and log hierarchy issue
Test should fail and log missing/incorrect mailto link

BoundaryValues.scenario: Minimum content: Only required headers and one button present
BoundaryValues.expected: Page should still pass if all required elements are present and functional

BoundaryValues.scenario: Maximum content: Additional unrelated buttons/links present
BoundaryValues.expected: Test should only validate required elements and ignore extras
